definitions.explanation: The time of year when seeds are planted. An agricultural term for the optimal period to sow crops, which varies by region, climate, and crop type.

examples.english: Spring is the sowing season for rice.

examples.japanese: {播種期|はしゅき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逃|のが}す→逃す：04611_nogasu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{収穫|しゅうかく}→収穫：03207_shuukaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Missing the sowing season will affect the harvest.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧{播種期|はしゅき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{農家|のうか}→農家：03539_nouka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧だ。
examples.english: The sowing season differs by region, so it's best to ask local farmers.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{播種|はしゅ}→播種：08745_hashu⟧ (sowing, seeding) and {期|き} (period, season). ⟦{播種|はしゅ}→播種：08745_hashu⟧ itself combines {播|は} (to sow, to scatter) and ⟦{種|しゅ}→種：28584_shu⟧ (seed). An agricultural term that appears in farming guides, weather reports during planting season, and discussions of traditional farming calendars.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {播種期|はしゅき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter the sowing season
- {播種期|はしゅき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to welcome the sowing season
- ⟦{適正|てきせい}→適正：09686_tekisei⟧{播種期|はしゅき}: optimal sowing period
- {播種期|はしゅき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おく}れる→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧: the sowing season is delayed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{種|たね}まき→種まき：08104_tanemaki⟧: seed sowing — the native Japanese word for the same activity, more common in everyday speech
- ⟦{田植|たう}え→田植え：22734_taue⟧: rice planting — specifically transplanting rice seedlings into paddies
- ⟦{収穫期|しゅうかくき}→収穫期：21343_shuukakuki⟧: harvest season — the counterpart period at the end of the growing cycle
